Form.ruleUnique: One you don't use anywhere else
Form.password_too_common: This password is too easy to guess. Try a few unrelated words together.
Form.invalidEmail: Enter an email address, like name@yourbusiness.com.
Form.invalidRequest: Some details can't be used. Check them and try again.
Form.busy: ziftbook is busy right now. Try again in a moment.
Form.unreachable: We couldn't reach ziftbook. Check your connection and try again.
Form.unexpected: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
Form.noScript: This page needs JavaScript to keep your link private. Turn it on in your browser, then open the link from the email again.
Form.needsJavaScript: This page needs JavaScript. Turn it on in your browser, then reload the page.

Inbox.title: Check your inbox
Inbox.signUpLede: We sent a link to <chip>{email}</chip>. Open it on any device within 24 hours to set up your business.
Inbox.resetLede: If an account uses <chip>{email}</chip>, a link is on its way. It works for 15 minutes.
Inbox.hint: Nothing after a few minutes? Look in your spam folder, or send it again.
Inbox.resendReady: You can send the link again.

SignUp.title: Create your business
SignUp.heading: Create your ziftbook
SignUp.lede: Start with your email. We send a link to confirm it's yours.
SignUp.tooMany: You've asked for several links in a short time. Wait an hour and try again.

CompleteSignUp.title: Set up your business
CompleteSignUp.lede: Your email is confirmed. A few last details and you're in.
CompleteSignUp.businessHint: Clients see this when they book. You can change it later.
CompleteSignUp.countryHint: Sets your currency, plus a starting time zone and language. The currency can't be changed later.
CompleteSignUp.expiredLede: Confirmation links work once, for 24 hours. Enter your email and we'll send a fresh one.
CompleteSignUp.existsLede: This email is already registered with ziftbook, so nothing was created or changed. Sign in to reach your business.

SignIn.title: Sign in
SignIn.invalid: That email and password don't match. Check both, or reset your password.
SignIn.tooMany: Too many attempts for now. Wait 15 minutes and try again, or reset your password.
SignIn.noBusiness: This account isn't part of a business any more. Ask the owner to add you again.

ForgotPassword.title: Reset your password
ForgotPassword.lede: Enter the email you sign in with. We'll send a link to choose a new password.
ForgotPassword.tooMany: You've asked for several reset links in a short time. Wait an hour and try again.

ResetPassword.title: Choose a new password
ResetPassword.lede: Once it's saved, you're signed out on every device, so anyone else who had access is out too.
ResetPassword.doneLede: You've been signed out everywhere, this device included. Sign in with your new password.
ResetPassword.expiredLede: Reset links work once, for 15 minutes. Your password hasn't changed. Ask for a new link to try again.

Invite.title: Accept your invite
Invite.noLink: This page only works from the link in your invite email, to keep it private. Open that link again.
Invite.tooMany: Too many attempts for now. Wait 15 minutes and try again.
Invite.newLede: Choose a password to see your appointments and working hours.
Invite.existingLede: Sign in with your ziftbook password to see your appointments here too.
Invite.wrongPassword: That password isn't right. Try again, or reset it.
Invite.accountExists: This email now has a ziftbook account. Enter its password to accept.
Invite.expiredLede: Invite links work once, for 7 days. Ask the business owner to send you a new invite.
Invite.memberLede: You already work there, so nothing changed. Sign in to see your appointments.

person.setName: Set a name clients can see
person.notFound: This person could not be found.

today.ownerEmptyBody: Clients can book once you have a service and working hours. It takes about five minutes.
today.step1: Set when the shop is open
today.step4: Invite the people who work with you
today.stepsHint: Opening hours come first: everyone's working hours sit inside them. Step four is optional. If you work alone, your own working hours are enough.
today.workerEmptyBody: New appointments appear here as clients book them.

empty.title: No services yet
empty.body: A service is what a client books: what it is called, how long it takes and what it costs. Most businesses start with two or three.

services.workerNote: Only the owner can change services. You see them here so you know what each one includes.
services.rowMetaPeople: {minutes} min · {price} · {n, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}
services.warningPill: No one assigned, so nobody can book it
services.archivedHint: Archived services stay on past appointments and reports. Clients cannot book them.
services.unknownMember: Someone you chose is no longer on the team. Reload and choose again.

form.namePlaceholder: Leave empty to show the {language} name
form.nameHint: Clients see the name in their own language, else your business language, else whichever one you've set.
form.nameRequired: Enter a name in at least one language.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: What the client can expect. Up to 1000 characters.
form.priceHint: Your currency is {currency}, set when the business was created. Everyone sees this same amount, written the way their own language writes numbers.
form.priceInvalid: Enter a price, using one comma or dot for the cents.
form.durationRange: Enter a duration between 5 and 720 minutes.
form.gapHint: Time to tidy up before the next client. It is never offered as a slot.
form.gapDefaultHint: {pct}% of the time booked, so {n} minutes here
form.gapFixedLabel: Set a fixed gap for this service
form.gapRange: Enter a gap between 0 and 240 minutes.
form.whoHint: Clients can only book a service with someone who performs it.
form.unnamedMetaCreate: {email} · Staff · clients see no name yet
form.archiveZoneBody: Clients stop seeing it straight away. Appointments already booked keep it, and so do your reports. You can bring it back at any time.
form.archiveConfirmBodyNone: Nobody performs this service. Archiving does not cancel appointments that are already booked.
form.archiveConfirmBodyOne: One person performs this service. Archiving does not cancel appointments that are already booked.
form.archiveConfirmBodyMany: {n} people perform this service. Archiving does not cancel appointments that are already booked.

errors.ownerOnly: Only an owner can do this.
errors.signedOut: Your session ended. Sign in again in a new tab, then try again here. <link>Sign in</link>

Console.notSaved: Nothing was saved, and your details are still here.

week.savingHint: Saving the whole week at once. Nothing changes for clients until it is saved.
week.attentionHint: {count, plural, =1 {One day needs attention.} =2 {Two days need attention.} =3 {Three days need attention.} =4 {Four days need attention.} =5 {Five days need attention.} =6 {Six days need attention.} =7 {Seven days need attention.} other {# days need attention.}}
week.notSaved: The week was not saved. {count, plural, =1 {One day needs attention} =2 {Two days need attention} =3 {Three days need attention} =4 {Four days need attention} =5 {Five days need attention} =6 {Six days need attention} =7 {Seven days need attention} other {# days need attention}}: {list}.
week.fieldEndNotAfterStart: The end time has to come after the start time. Hours that run past midnight are set as two days.
week.fieldOverlapping: These two blocks cover {from} to {to} twice. Change one of them.
week.phraseOutsideOpeningHours: {weekday} falls outside the shop's opening hours
week.tooMany: This week has too many blocks to save. Remove a few and try again.
week.fieldOutsideOpeningHours: This falls outside the shop's opening hours.
week.serverEndNotAfterStart: One of the end times has to come after its start time. Check each day and try again.
week.serverOverlapping: Two blocks in this week overlap. Check each day and try again.

opening.editorLede: When the shop is open. Times are in {city} time.

empty.title: The shop has no opening hours yet
empty.body: These are the times the shop is open. Everything sits inside them: each person works part of the week, blocked time comes out of that, and what is left is what clients can book.
empty.hint: Opening hours are the first setup step: everyone's working hours sit inside them.

opening.note: Nobody can work outside these times, and nothing can be booked outside them. <link>See who works when</link>
opening.shortenHint: Shortening a day leaves any working hours outside the new times unbookable. The people who work then keep their hours; clients simply stop being offered those slots.
opening.twoBlockHint: Two blocks close the shop in between: nothing is booked from {from} to {to}.
opening.removeOnly: Close the shop on {weekday}, removing {from} to {to}
opening.allClosedRefusal: Open the shop on at least one day.
opening.saved: Saved. Clients can only book while the shop is open.

team.onlyYouTitle: It is just you right now
team.onlyYouBody: Invite someone and they get their own sign-in, their own working hours and their own appointments. You decide which services they perform.
team.onlyYouHint: Working alone is fine. Set your own working hours and clients can start booking.

invites.expiresIn: Invite expires in {n, plural, one {one day} other {# days}}
invites.invitedHint: Someone who has not accepted yet cannot sign in and takes no appointments. Their name can be set once they accept.
invites.alreadyMember: This person is already on your team.
invites.rateLimited: Too many invites for now. Try again in an hour.

hours.emptyBody: Add the times this person is at work each week. Clients can only book inside them, so nothing is bookable until they exist.
hours.emptyHintBounded: The shop is open {days}. Working hours sit inside those times, so a day the shop is closed cannot be worked. <link>Change the opening hours</link>
hours.emptyHintBoundedWorker: The shop is open {days}. Working hours sit inside those times, so a day the shop is closed cannot be worked. Ask your owner to change the opening hours.
hours.twoBlockHint: Two blocks make a break: nothing can be booked between {from} and {to}.
hours.saved: Saved. Clients see these times straight away.
hours.noteBounded: Working hours sit inside the shop's opening hours, shown under each day. <link>Change the opening hours</link>
hours.noteBoundedWorker: Your hours sit inside the shop's opening hours, shown under each day. Only an owner can change those.
hours.lockedNoteBounded: Your owner sets these hours, inside the shop's opening hours: {days}. Ask them to change them. You can still block time when you are not available.
hours.lockedNoteUnbounded: Your owner sets these hours. Ask them to change them. You can still block time when you are not available.
